sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: The posting URL we were given, unchanged.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which board the URL belongs to. Null when the URL is not one we recognise at all.

company.title: Company slug
company.description: Board slug taken from the URL path.

jobId.title: Job id
jobId.description: The board API's own job key, taken from the URL path. Only lever, ashby and rippling put it there.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Why this row has, or has not, lifecycle facts. Only `tracked` carries them; the rest exist so an empty row is never read as 'this job never closed'.

historyTrackedSince.title: History tracked since
historyTrackedSince.description: First day we watched this board. Every date here is censored at this one.

historyWindowDays.title: History window (days)
historyWindowDays.description: How many days we have watched the board. A small number cannot support a claim about the posting's whole life.

firstSeen.title: First seen
firstSeen.description: First day we saw this posting. Not its posting date.

firstSeenCensored.title: First seen is censored
firstSeenCensored.description: True when the posting was already up when we started watching, so firstSeen is a floor on its age rather than its age. On 2026-09-05 this was true of 90% of recorded removals.

postedAt.title: Posted at
postedAt.description: The board's own posted date, when it publishes one. This is the real age and it beats our first sighting.

ageDays.title: Age (days)
ageDays.description: Days since postedAt when the board gave one, else since firstSeen.

ageBasis.title: Age basis
ageBasis.description: board = the employer's own date; observed = our first sighting; observed_floor = our first sighting on a posting that was already up, so the age is a floor.

stillListed.title: Still listed
stillListed.description: True when the posting is on the board today. Null, never false, when we cannot say — a missing id is not an observed removal.

duplicateOf.title: Duplicate of
duplicateOf.description: Set when an earlier row in this run resolved to the same posting. The row is still returned; it is not charged twice.

status.title: Board fetch status
status.description: Always null here, and named so the omission is explicit rather than an oversight. The published age index carries live postings only, not the daily sweep's per-board result, so none of ok, not_found, unconfirmed, rate_limited, http_error, parse_error, timeout, max_jobs_reached, budget_exhausted, no_companies, unresolved_domain, provider_unavailable or provider_degraded can be reported. Use `coverage` instead.
